profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: under construction as of this session (Fairfax County approved, construction commenced Q1 2025, Dominion delivering 67.2MW utility power from Lincoln Park Substation energized Dec 2024). 48MW critical IT written as planned_it_capacity_mw, not operating capacity.

reading.body:
Menlo Digital's MD-DC1 in Herndon, Virginia is under construction with 48 megawatts of planned IT capacity and 67.2 megawatts of utility power already connected as of December 2024.

The facility spans 307,498 square feet across the MD-VA1 campus in Fairfax County. Dominion Energy energized the Lincoln Park Substation connection in late 2024, ahead of the data center's operational timeline. Construction commenced in the first quarter of 2025 following Fairfax County approval.

The 67.2 megawatts of utility power exceeds the planned 48 megawatts of IT capacity, indicating either planned headroom for future expansion, losses in power delivery, or cooling infrastructure. This gap between utility supply and compute capacity is typical in data center design but constrains how much computing load can actually run at this location.

The research underlying this profile is complete as of September 2026. The facility remains under construction and has not yet reported operating capacity.
